question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing left back, Bob is playing left winger, Claire is playing center midfielder, Dave is playing striker, Eve is playing goalkeeper, Fred is playing right midfielder, and Gertrude is playing right winger.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Eve and Bob trade positions. Then, Dave and Bob trade positions. Then, Claire and Alice trade positions. Then, Bob and Claire trade positions. Then, Dave and Eve trade positions. Then, Eve and Alice trade positions. Finally, Bob and Claire trade positions. At the end of the match, Eve is playing
Options:
(A) left back
(B) left winger
(C) center midfielder
(D) striker
(E) goalkeeper
(F) right midfielder
(G) right winger
solution:
Position order in every row: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: left back, left winger, center midfielder, striker, goalkeeper, right midfielder, right winger
1. Eve–Bob: left back, goalkeeper, center midfielder, striker, left winger, right midfielder, right winger
2. Dave–Bob: left back, striker, center midfielder, goalkeeper, left winger, right midfielder, right winger
3. Claire–Alice: center midfielder, striker, left back, goalkeeper, left winger, right midfielder, right winger
4. Bob–Claire: center midfielder, left back, striker, goalkeeper, left winger, right midfielder, right winger
5. Dave–Eve: center midfielder, left back, striker, left winger, goalkeeper, right midfielder, right winger
6. Eve–Alice: goalkeeper, left back, striker, left winger, center midfielder, right midfielder, right winger
7. Bob–Claire: goalkeeper, striker, left back, left winger, center midfielder, right midfielder, right winger
Eve's final position is center midfielder, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
